purpose: Additive traceability records for full Brain convergence modules. This registry supplements, never replaces or narrows, the canonical source-requirement registry.

code_module_records.owner_object: Tenant identity, membership, role and database-isolation runtime

code_module_records.state_machine: signed tenant and actor identity -> signature verification -> active membership resolution -> trusted TenantContext -> transaction-local tenant/actor SQL settings -> RLS -> scoped operation; malformed, untrusted or cross-tenant paths fail closed

signed tenant identity resolves roles from persisted membership
database sessions receive only verified tenant and actor context
RLS fails cross-tenant access closed
mutable in-process projections are partitioned by tenant
tenant mode requires durable membership authority

unresolved_gaps: legacy/global row backfill remains table-specific HOLD
production non-owner non-BYPASSRLS runtime-role verification remains deployment evidence
worker-side tenant context requires separate convergence
